description: Embrace timeless style and practicality with Rothco's Swiss Style Wool Blanket. The vintage inspired wool blanket features a tan woven wool material adorned with a bold red stripe. Versatile and durable, this blanket is your perfect companion for camping, survival, and outdoor adventures. Crafted from a blend of 55% wool and 45% synthetic material, the camping blanket offers superior warmth and moisture-trapping capabilities, keeping you snug and dry in any weather condition. Additionally, the wool material is naturally fire-retardant, ensuring safety during outdoor activities. Measuring 60 inches by 80 inches, the outdoor blanket is perfectly sized to fit a camping cot and conveniently fits into a rucksack for easy transport. Whether you're comfortableing up by the campfire or braving the elements in the wilderness, this Swiss Style Wool Blanket is an essential addition to your outdoor gear collection, providing both comfort and functionality when you need it most.
